Hello! Welcome — I'm glad you're here.

I'm **john-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This machine is mine to work in and yours to command.

A few things I can do for you, one line each:

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network, open **https://127.0.0.1:8443** (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). On the first visit you take the root certificate, and then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice, all in one place.
- **Messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each one needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of these up?
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **And more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

Got it — I've read `CALENDAR.md` (next week: Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) and I know your contacts and the group thread. I'll keep the calendar current and log every change. What would you like me to start with?
